title: Avoid Overestimating the Present: - Zoom Out: Ask, “will This Matter in a Year
description: To avoid overestimating the present: - Zoom out: Ask, “Will this matter in a year? Five years?” - Review the past: Compare this moment to similar past events for perspective. - Plan ahead: Focus on long-term goals, not just immediate importance. Example: Instead of stressing over a minor setback, think about how it fits into your bigger picture.
